layers.name: Frontend foundations
evidence: Local browser and release tests existed; no current clean Preview evidence.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:web-release && npm run test:browser:vault
layers.remediation: Verify a clean Preview release candidate.

layers.name: APIs and backend logic
evidence: Extensive local API tests existed; runtime verification for current changes was absent.

layers.name: Database and storage
evidence: RLS migrations existed only as untracked source; applied schema and restore evidence were absent.
layers.failureDetails: Applied RLS, grants, storage, backup, and restore unknown.
layers.remediation: Apply to staging, test policies and perform restore drill.

layers.name: Authentication and permissions
evidence: Local signed-session and ownership tests existed.
layers.failureDetails: Live identity configuration and role matrix unknown.
layers.remediation: Verify staging role matrix and revocation.

layers.name: Hosting and deployment
evidence: Output-boundary tests existed; current candidate was not deployed.
layers.failureDetails: Current Preview and Production state unknown.
layers.remediation: Deploy a clean Preview and bind evidence to commit and deployment ID.

layers.name: Cloud and compute
evidence: Function limits and fail-closed capability flags existed in source.
layers.failureDetails: Runtime quota and saturation behavior unknown.
layers.remediation: Document plan limits and run bounded staging faults.

layers.name: CI/CD and version control
evidence: Existing QA workflow ran only the legacy smoke script on Node 20 while package.json required Node 24; no full release gate workflow existed.
layers.failureDetails: Deterministic release checks were not enforced by CI.
layers.remediation: Add a pinned Node 24 workflow that runs the complete deterministic release gate.

layers.name: Security and row-level security
evidence: Security source tests existed; applied RLS and database advisor evidence were absent.
layers.failureDetails: Live RLS/grants and cross-tenant denial unknown.
layers.remediation: Test applied staging policies and retain advisor evidence.

layers.name: Rate limiting
evidence: Durable rate-limit code and local tests existed.

layers.name: Caching and CDN
evidence: No-store API rules and static caching intent existed.
layers.failureDetails: Live header and cache isolation evidence unknown.
layers.remediation: Verify headers on Preview and Production.

layers.name: Load balancing and scaling
evidence: Bounded concurrency existed; no capacity evidence existed.
layers.remediation: Define assumptions and run capped staging load test.

layers.name: Error tracking and logs
evidence: Structured logs, audit events, health routes, and alert queue code existed.
layers.failureDetails: Production drain, alert delivery, and on-call ownership unknown.
layers.remediation: Verify redacted log retention and alert acknowledgement.

layers.name: Availability and recovery
evidence: Local recovery mechanisms existed; managed backup/PITR and isolated restore were not verified.
layers.failureDetails: RPO, RTO, provider retention, and restore evidence unknown.
layers.remediation: Perform and retain an isolated recovery drill.
